summary: Static source review of the standalone Flutter/Firebase project completed. Required files and credential-free configuration are present, but live Firebase, Flutter analysis, Android build, and OTP behavior could not run because the required SDKs and client configuration are unavailable.

critical.issue: A signed-in phone user may create an active users profile with any role because create only checks that an authorized_users document exists; it does not require that document to be active or constrain role/active/phone to the authorized record. This can enable self-provisioning as admin/teacher.

Any active teacher can create attendance records for arbitrary students and classes when only teacherUid equality is checked; the teacher assignment constraint used for attendance_sessions is not applied to records.

minor.issue: Teacher updates are allowed for their own session without immutable-field checks, so teacher-owned session fields can be rewritten after submission.

integration_issues.issue: NotificationService.configureTapHandling() is defined but never invoked, so notification-open deep navigation hooks are not configured.

action_items: Tighten /users create rules: require authorized_users phone match, active true, and copy/validate role and active server-side; do not allow client-selected privileged roles.
Apply teacher_assignments validation to attendance_records create/update and restrict immutable teacher/session/student fields.
Invoke configureTapHandling during app startup or authenticated notification setup.
On a machine with Flutter, Firebase CLI, Android SDK, and generated FlutterFire options, run flutter pub get, flutter analyze, flutter test, Android build, and live Firebase integration tests.
critical_code_review_comments: firebase_options.dart is intentionally a throwing placeholder; the app cannot proceed beyond setup until FlutterFire configuration is generated.
No credentials were found in source; test_credentials.md is empty, so no auth test credentials exist for live OTP testing.
Static import/file inventory and JSON/Node syntax checks were previously documented as passing; no compiler or Firebase emulator validation was possible here.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Review only covered /app/ecampus_flutter. Do not use the existing Expo app. Required Flutter/Dart/Firebase tooling and Firebase client credentials remain unavailable.
rca_of_issue: The primary authorization flaw is in the Firestore create rule rather than the UI: the client reads authorized_users and writes a role-bearing users document, while rules validate only document existence. A malicious authenticated phone client can bypass the intended AuthScreen checks and submit a privileged profile directly. Attendance record rules similarly omit the assignment predicate enforced for sessions.
